import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots for comprehensive analysis
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Digital Camera Specifications Analysis (1000 Cameras)', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# Color palette
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", n_colors=8)

# 1. Price vs Megapixels by Sensor Type (scatter plot)
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
sensor_types = df['sensor_type'].unique()
for i, sensor in enumerate(sensor_types):
    sensor_data = df[df['sensor_type'] == sensor]
    ax1.scatter(sensor_data['megapixels'], sensor_data['price_usd'], 
               alpha=0.6, s=50, label=sensor, color=colors[i % len(colors)])
ax1.set_xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Price vs Megapixels by Sensor Type', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax1.legend(title='Sensor Type', fontsize=8, title_fontsize=9)
ax1.grid(alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 2. Average Price by Brand (bar plot - top 8 brands by count)
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
top_brands = df['brand'].value_counts().head(8).index
brand_data = df[df['brand'].isin(top_brands)].groupby('brand').agg({
    'price_usd': 'mean'
}).sort_values('price_usd', ascending=False)
bars = ax2.barh(brand_data.index, brand_data['price_usd'], color=colors[:len(brand_data)])
ax2.set_xlabel('Average Price (USD)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Brand', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Average Price by Top Brands', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax2.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')
for i, (idx, val) in enumerate(brand_data.iterrows()):
    ax2.text(val['price_usd'] + 50, i, f'${val["price_usd"]:.0f}', 
            va='center', fontsize=9)

# 3. Camera Evolution: Megapixels and 4K Video over Years
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
year_data = df.groupby('model_year').agg({
    'megapixels': 'mean',
    'has_video_4k': 'mean'
}).reset_index()
ax3_twin = ax3.twinx()
line1 = ax3.plot(year_data['model_year'], year_data['megapixels'], 
                marker='o', linewidth=2.5, color='#2E86AB', label='Avg Megapixels')
line2 = ax3_twin.plot(year_data['model_year'], year_data['has_video_4k'] * 100, 
                     marker='s', linewidth=2.5, color='#A23B72', label='4K Video %')
ax3.set_xlabel('Model Year', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('Average Megapixels', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', color='#2E86AB')
ax3_twin.set_ylabel('% with 4K Video', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', color='#A23B72')
ax3.set_title('Camera Technology Evolution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax3.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor='#2E86AB')
ax3_twin.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor='#A23B72')
ax3.grid(alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')
lines = line1 + line2
labels = [l.get_label() for l in lines]
ax3.legend(lines, labels, loc='upper left', fontsize=9)

# 4. Weight Distribution by Body Type (violin plot)
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
body_types = df['body_type'].value_counts().head(4).index
filtered_df = df[df['body_type'].isin(body_types)]
violin_parts = ax4.violinplot([filtered_df[filtered_df['body_type'] == bt]['weight_grams'].values 
                               for bt in body_types],
                              positions=range(len(body_types)),
                              widths=0.7,
                              showmeans=True,
                              showmedians=True)
for pc in violin_parts['bodies']:
    pc.set_facecolor('#6A994E')
    pc.set_alpha(0.7)
ax4.set_xticks(range(len(body_types)))
ax4.set_xticklabels(body_types, rotation=15, ha='right')
ax4.set_ylabel('Weight (grams)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Weight Distribution by Body Type', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
